header.running_head: Visiting the Ill and What to say to them

blocks.text:
Rawaaha (RA). When the dust kicked up by the animal engulfed the gathering, Abdullaah bin Ubay covered his nose with his shawl saying, "Do not kick dust on us!"
Rasulullaah ﷺ then greeted, stopped and dismounted. He invited them towards Allaah and also recited the Qur'aan to them. Abdullaah bin Ubay responded by sneering, "Dear man! If what you say is the truth, there can be nothing better than it. However, do not disturb us with it in our gatherings. Rather return to your home and address those of us who come to you."
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rawaaha (RA) then said, "Do carry on, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Continue coming to us in our gatherings because we enjoy it." The Muslims, Mushrikeen and Jews then started hurling abuse at each other until matters reached such a head that they almost came to blows. All the time, Rasulullaah ﷺ continued calming them until they all fell still. Rasulullaah ﷺ then mounted his animal and when he entered the home of Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA), he asked, "O Sa'd! Did you hear what Abu Hubaab just said?" Here Rasulullaah ﷺ was referring to Abdullah bin Ubay. Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) said, "Forgive him, Rasulullaah ﷺ, and overlook what he said. Allaah has given you (the status and honour) He has granted you whereas (just before you arrived) the people of this city had unanimously decided to crown him and to make him their chief. This was however put off by the truth that Allaah sent with you and this has stuck in his throat. It is because of this (jealousy for you) that he is doing what you see."[^1]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once visited a villager. Whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ visited a sick person, he would say:

blocks.arabic_text: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُوْرٌ إِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ
blocks.text:
"Do not worry, this is a means of cleansing sins if Allaah wills"
Rasulullaah ﷺ therefore said this to the villager, who in turn said, "A means of cleansing sins?! Never! This fever has attacked an old man very viciously and will leave him only when he reaches the grave." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "It will then be as you say." (The man then died of the condition).[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) Fall Ill Upon Arrival in Madinah

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ arrived in Madinah, both Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) suffered extreme fever. She went to them both and asked, "Dear father! How are you? O Bilaal! How are you?" When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)'s fever rose, he recited some couplets which meant:
